articles.summary: Oblenio Bio is a clinical-stage company pursuing broad immune reset as a transformative therapy for refractory autoimmune diseases through its LBL-051 T cell engager. Specifically engineered for autoimmune patients, this tri-specific unites validated targets BCMA, CD19 and CD3 to safely and completely deplete B cells and plasma cells to achieve long-term drug-free remission.
